text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I drop by Nakayama Racecourse and spot a pair of familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I see… So what would you say Nakayama Racecourse means to you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Well, it's a place I always dreamed of, and one my grandmother held fondly in her memories.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Didn't see you there.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Actually, I've received requests from quite a few outlets, not just Twinkle Monthly.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I have an interview with Turbo Turf WEB in eight minutes, then The Nakayama Sleuth twenty-five minutes after that, and in fifty minutes, um…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Not at all! It's the least I can do.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: The students are working so hard. I have to do my part to make our next concert even bigger!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can see the determination in her eyes.
choice_data_list: I'll go get you something to drink.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can see the determination in her eyes.
choice_data_list: I'll go get you something to drink.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: O-oh, no, you really don't have to! I can get something myse—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her voice sounds hoarse. It must be worn out after so many interviews.
choice_data_list: I'll pick up some cough drops while I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: …Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Sorry for the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Excuse me? Hi, I'm with Turbo Turf WEB…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Oh, y-yes! I'm Light Hello! Pleased to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And, um, Trainer? I really appreciate the help!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'll return the favor someday! Okay, gotta run now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, an extravagant box of sweets is delivered to my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Written on the wrapping paper in neat letters are my and <chrname>'s names along with a big "Thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, are you sure? Aren't you off today?
choice_data_list: I want to do my part to help them shine too.
I want to do my part to help them shine too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: …Right, how could I forget? You know the girls far better than me!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Excuse me? I'm with Turbo Turf… got here a little early.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: That's quite all right! We can get right to the interview!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And Trainer, thank you for offering to help out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello and I sit for an interview with the reporter.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: …I had no idea it would take so long. Sorry to eat up so much of your time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I was really impressed with how in-depth your answers were, though. I guess it only makes sense, given how much time you spend with the students.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: …I need to step up my game!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'll learn from your answers and use them in my interviews tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes! I want to do everything I can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The passion and persistence Light Hello demonstrates in her work continues to amaze me…
